ayahs.1: Allah Taala ka hukm aa pahuncha, ab is ki jaldi na machao. Tamaam paaki is ke liye hai, woh bartar hai un sab se jinhein yeh Allah ke nazdeek shareek batlaate hain.
ayahs.2: Wohi farishton ko apni wahi de kar apne hukm se apne bandon mein se jis par chaahta hai utaarta hai ke tum logon ko aagaah kar do ke mere siwa aur koi mabood nahi, pas tum mujh se daro.
ayahs.3: Usi ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko haq ke saath paida kiya, woh is se bari hai jo mushrik karte hain.
ayahs.4: Us ne insaan ko nutfe se paida kiya phir woh sareeh jhagdaalu ban baitha.
ayahs.5: Usi ne chaupaaye paida kiye jin mein tumhare liye garmi ke libaas hain aur bhi bahut se nafa hain aur baaz tumhare khaane ke kaam aate hain.
ayahs.6: Aur in mein tumhari raunaq bhi hai jab chara kar laao tab bhi aur jab charaane le jaao tab bhi.
ayahs.7: Aur woh tumhare bojh un shehron tak utha le jaate hain jahaan tum baghair aadhi jaan kiye pahunch hi nahi sakte the. Yaqeenan tumhara Rabb bada hi shafeeq aur nihaayat mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.8: Ghodon ko, khachchron ko, gadhon ko is ne paida kiya ke tum in ki sawaari lo aur woh baais-e-zeenat bhi hain. Aur bhi woh aisi bahut cheezein paida karta hai jin ka tumhein ilm bhi nahi.
ayahs.9: Aur Allah par seedhi raah ka bata dena hai aur baaz tedhi raahein hain, aur agar woh chaahta to tum sab ko raah-e-raast par laga deta.
ayahs.10: Wohi tumhare faaide ke liye aasmaan se paani barsaata hai jise tum peete bhi ho aur usi se uge hue darakhton ko tum apne jaanwaron ko charaate ho.
ayahs.11: Usi se woh tumhare liye kheti aur zaitoon aur khajoor aur angoor aur har qisam ke phal ugaata hai, be-shak in logon ke liye to is mein badi nishaani hai jo ghaur-o-fikr karte hain.
ayahs.12: Usi ne raat din aur sooraj chaand ko tumhare liye taabe kar diya hai aur sitaare bhi usi ke hukm ke maatehat hain. Yaqeenan is mein aqalmand logon ke liye kayi ek nishaaniyaan maujood hain.
ayahs.13: Aur bhi bahut si cheezein tarah tarah ke rang-roop ki is ne tumhare liye zameen par phaila rakhi hain. Beshak naseehat qabool karne walon ke liye is mein badi bhaari nishaani hai.
ayahs.14: Aur darya bhi usi ne tumhare bas mein kar diye hain ke tum is mein se (nikla hua) taaza gosht khaao aur is mein se apne pehnne ke zewaraat nikaal sako aur tum dekhte ho ke kashtiyan is mein paani cheerti hui (chalti) hain aur is liye bhi ke tum is ka fazl talaash karo aur ho sakta hai ke tum shukr-guzaari bhi karo.
ayahs.15: Aur is ne zameen mein pahaad gaad diye hain taake tumhein le kar hile na, aur nehrein aur raahein bana dein taake tum manzil-e-maqsood ko pahuncho.
ayahs.16: Aur bhi bahut si nishaaniyaan muqarrar farmaayin. Aur sitaaron se bhi log raah haasil karte hain.
ayahs.17: To kya woh jo paida karta hai us jaisa hai jo paida nahi kar sakta? Kya tum bilkul nahi sochte?
ayahs.18: Aur agar tum Allah ki nematon ka shumaar karna chaaho to tum use nahi kar sakte. Beshak Allah bada bakhshne wala mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.19: Aur jo kuch tum chhupaao aur zaahir karo Allah Taala sab kuch jaanta hai.
ayahs.20: Aur jin jin ko yeh log Allah Taala ke siwa pukaarte hain woh kisi cheez ko paida nahi kar sakte, balke woh khud paida kiye hue hain.
ayahs.21: Murde hain, zinda nahi, unhein to yeh bhi shaoor nahi ke kab uthaaye jaayenge.
ayahs.22: Tum sab ka mabood sirf Allah Taala akela hai aur aakhirat par imaan na rakhne walon ke dil munkir hain aur woh khud takabbur se bhare hue hain.
ayahs.23: Be-shak-o-shubha Allah Taala har us cheez ko, jise woh log chhupaate hain aur jise zaahir karte hain, ba-khoobi jaanta hai. Woh ghuroor karne walon ko pasand nahi farmaata.
ayahs.24: Un se jab daryaaft kiya jaata hai ke tumhare parwardigaar ne kya naazil farmaaya hai? To jawaab dete hain ke aglon ki kahaaniyan hain.
ayahs.25: Isi ka nateeja hoga ke qayamat ke din yeh log apne poore bojh ke saath hi un ke bojh ke bhi hisse-daar honge jinhein be-ilmi se gumraah karte rahe. Dekho to kaisa bura bojh utha rahe hain.
ayahs.26: In se pehle ke logon ne bhi makr kiya tha, (aakhir) Allah ne (un ke mansoobon) ki imaarton ko jadon se ukheed diya aur un (ke saron) par (un ki) chhatein oopar se gir padin, aur un ke paas azaab wahaan se aa gaya jahaan ka unhein waham-o-gumaan bhi na tha.
ayahs.27: Phir qayamat wale din bhi Allah Taala unhein ruswa karega aur farmaayega ke mere woh shareek kahaan hain jin ke baare mein tum ladte jhagadte the, jinhein ilm diya gaya tha woh pukaar uthenge ke aaj to kaafiron ko ruswaai aur buraai chimat gayi.
ayahs.28: Woh jo apni jaanon par zulm karte hain, farishte jab un ki jaan qabz karne lagte hain us waqt woh jhuk jaate hain ke hum buraai nahi karte the. Kyun nahi? Allah Taala khoob jaanne wala hai jo kuch tum karte the.
ayahs.29: Pas ab to hameshgi ke taur par tum jahannam ke darwaazon mein daakhil ho jaao, pas kya hi bura thikaana hai ghuroor karne walon ka.
ayahs.30: Aur parhezgaaron se poochha jaata hai ke tumhare parwardigaar ne kya naazil farmaaya hai? To woh jawaab dete hain ke achche se achcha. Jin logon ne bhalaai ki un ke liye is dunya mein bhalaai hai, aur yaqeenan aakhirat ka ghar to bahut hi behtar hai, aur kya hi khoob parhezgaaron ka ghar hai.
ayahs.31: Hameshgi wale baaghaat jahaan woh jaayenge jin ke neeche nehrein beh rahi hain, jo kuch yeh talab karenge wahaan un ke liye maujood hoga. Parhezgaaron ko Allah Taala isi tarah badle ata farmaata hai.
ayahs.32: Woh jin ki jaanein farishte is haal mein qabz karte hain ke woh paak saaf hon, kehte hain ke tumhare liye salaamati hi salaamati hai, jaao jannat mein apne un aamaal ke badle jo tum karte the.
ayahs.33: Kya yeh isi baat ka intezaar kar rahe hain ke un ke paas farishte aa jaayen ya tere Rabb ka hukm aa jaaye? Aisa hi un logon ne bhi kiya tha jo un se pehle the. Un par Allah Taala ne koi zulm nahi kiya balke woh khud apni jaanon par zulm karte rahe.
ayahs.34: Pas un ke bure aamaal ke nateeje unhein mil gaye aur jis ki hansi udaate the us ne un ko gher liya.
ayahs.35: Mushrik logon ne kaha ke agar Allah Taala chaahta to hum aur hamare baap daade is ke siwa kisi aur ki ibaadat hi na karte, na is ke farmaan ke baghair kisi cheez ko haraam karte. Yehi feil in se pehle ke logon ka raha. To Rasoolon par to sirf khullam-khulla paighaam ka pahuncha dena hai.
ayahs.36: Hum ne har ummat mein Rasool bheja ke (logo!) sirf Allah ki ibaadat karo aur is ke siwa tamaam maboodon se bacho. Pas baaz logon ko to Allah Taala ne hidayat di aur baaz par gumraahi saabit ho gayi, pas tum khud zameen mein chal phir kar dekh lo ke jhutlaane walon ka anjaam kaisa kuch hua?
ayahs.37: Go aap un ki hidayat ke khwahish-mand rahe hain lekin Allah Taala use hidayat nahi deta jise gumraah kar de aur na un ka koi madadgaar hota hai.
ayahs.38: Woh log badi sakht sakht qasmein kha kha kar kehte hain ke murdon ko Allah Taala zinda nahi karega. Kyun nahi zaroor zinda karega, yeh to is ka bar-haq laazmi waada hai, lekin aksar log jaante nahi.
ayahs.39: Is liye bhi ke yeh log jis cheez mein ikhtilaaf karte the use Allah Taala saaf bayaan kar de aur is liye bhi ke khud kaafir apna jhoota hona jaan len.
ayahs.40: Hum jab kisi cheez ka iraada karte hain to sirf hamara yeh keh dena hota hai ke ho ja, pas woh ho jaati hai.
ayahs.41: Jin logon ne zulm bardaasht karne ke baad Allah ki raah mein tark-e-watan kiya hai hum unhein behtar se behtar thikaana dunya mein ata farmaayenge aur aakhirat ka sawaab to bahut hi bada hai, kaash ke log is se waaqif hote.
ayahs.42: Woh jinhon ne daaman-e-sabr na chhoda aur apne paalne wale hi par bharosa karte rahe.
ayahs.43: Aap se pehle bhi hum mardon ko hi bhejte rahe, jin ki jaanib wahi utaara karte the, pas agar tum nahi jaante to ahl-e-ilm se daryaaft kar lo.
ayahs.44: Daleelon aur kitaabon ke saath, yeh zikr (kitaab) hum ne aap ki taraf utaara hai ke logon ki jaanib jo naazil farmaaya gaya hai aap use khol khol kar bayaan kar den, shaayad ke woh ghaur-o-fikr karen.
ayahs.45: Badtareen daanw-pech karne wale kya is baat se be-khauf ho gaye hain ke Allah Taala unhein zameen mein dhansa de ya un ke paas aisi jagah se azaab aa jaaye jahaan ka unhein waham-o-gumaan bhi na ho.
ayahs.46: Ya unhein chalte phirte pakad le, yeh kisi soorat mein Allah Taala ko aajiz nahi kar sakte.
ayahs.47: Ya unhein dara dhamka kar pakad le, pas yaqeenan tumhara parwardigaar aala shafqat aur intihaai rahm wala hai.
ayahs.48: Kya unhon ne Allah ki makhlooq mein se kisi ko bhi nahi dekha? Ke is ke saaye daayen baayen jhuk jhuk kar Allah Taala ke saamne sar-ba-sajood hote aur aajizi ka izhaar karte hain.
ayahs.49: Yaqeenan aasmaan-o-zameen ke kull jaandaar aur tamaam farishte Allah Taala ke saamne sajde karte hain aur zara bhi takabbur nahi karte.
ayahs.50: Aur apne Rabb se jo un ke oopar hai, kapkapaate rehte hain aur jo hukm mil jaaye is ki tameel karte hain.
ayahs.51: Allah Taala irshaad farma chuka hai ke do mabood na banaao. Mabood to sirf wohi akela hai, pas tum sab sirf mera hi dar-khauf rakho.
ayahs.52: Aasmaanon mein aur zameen mein jo kuch hai sab usi ka hai aur usi ki ibaadat laazim hai, kya phir tum is ke siwa auron se darte ho?
ayahs.53: Tumhare paas jitni bhi nematein hain sab usi ki di hui hain, ab bhi jab tumhein koi museebat pesh aa jaaye to usi ki taraf naala-o-faryaad karte ho.
ayahs.54: Aur jahaan us ne woh museebat tum se dafa kar di tum mein se kuch log apne Rabb ke saath shirk karne lag jaate hain.
ayahs.55: Ke hamari di hui nematon ki na-shukri karen. Achcha kuch faaida utha lo, aakhir-kaar tumhein maaloom ho hi jaayega.
ayahs.56: Aur jise jaante boojhte bhi nahi is ka hissa hamari di hui rozi mein se muqarrar karte hain, wallah tumhare is bohtan ka sawaal tum se zaroor hi kiya jaayega.
ayahs.57: Aur woh Allah Subhaanahu-wa-Taala ke liye ladkiyaan muqarrar karte hain aur apne liye woh jo apni khwahish ke mutaabiq ho.
ayahs.58: In mein se jab kisi ko ladki hone ki khabar di jaaye to is ka chehra siyaah ho jaata hai aur dil hi dil mein ghutne lagta hai.
ayahs.59: Is buri khabar ki wajah se logon se chhupa chhupa phirta hai. Sochta hai ke kya is ko zillat ke saath liye hue hi rahe ya use mitti mein daba de, aah! Kya hi bure faisle karte hain?
ayahs.60: Aakhirat par imaan na rakhne walon ki hi buri misaal hai, Allah ke liye to bahut hi buland sifat hai, woh bada hi ghalib aur ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.61: Agar logon ke gunaah par Allah Taala un ki giraft karta to roo-e-zameen par ek bhi jaandaar baaqi na rehta, lekin woh to unhein ek waqt-e-muqarrar tak dheel deta hai, jab un ka woh waqt aa jaata hai to woh ek saa-at na peechhe reh sakte hain aur na aage badh sakte hain.
ayahs.62: Aur woh apne liye jo na-pasand rakhte hain Allah ke liye saabit karte hain aur un ki zabaanein jhooti baatein bayaan karti hain ke un ke liye khoobi hai. Nahi nahi, dar-asal un ke liye aag hai aur yeh dozakhiyon ke pesh-rau hain.
ayahs.63: Wallah! Hum ne tujh se pehle ki ummaton ki taraf bhi apne Rasool bheje lekin shaitaan ne un ke aamaal-e-bad un ki nigaahon mein aaraasta kar diye, woh shaitaan aaj bhi un ka rafeeq bana hua hai aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.64: Is kitaab ko hum ne aap par is liye utaara hai ke aap un ke liye har us cheez ko waazeh kar den jis mein woh ikhtilaaf kar rahe hain aur yeh imaan walon ke liye rahnumaai aur rahmat hai.
ayahs.65: Aur Allah aasmaan se paani barsa kar is se zameen ko is ki maut ke baad zinda kar deta hai. Yaqeenan is mein un logon ke liye nishaani hai jo sunen.
ayahs.66: Tumhare liye to chaupaayon mein bhi badi ibrat hai ke hum tumhein is ke pet mein jo kuch hai usi mein se gobar aur lahu ke darmiyaan se khaalis doodh pilaate hain jo peene walon ke liye sehta pachta hai.
ayahs.67: Aur khajoor aur angoor ke darakhton ke phalon se tum sharaab bana lete ho aur umda rozi bhi. Jo log aqal rakhte hain un ke liye to is mein bahut badi nishaani hai.
ayahs.68: Aap ke Rabb ne shehad ki makhi ke dil mein yeh baat daal di ke pahaadon mein darakhton aur logon ki banaayi hui oonchi oonchi tattiyon mein apne ghar (chhatte) bana.
ayahs.69: Aur har tarah ke mewe kha aur apne Rabb ki aasaan raahon mein chalti phirti reh, in ke pet se rang-birang ka mashroob nikalta hai, jis ke rang mukhtalif hain aur jis mein logon ke liye shifa hai. Ghaur-o-fikr karne walon ke liye is mein bhi bahut badi nishaani hai.
ayahs.70: Allah Taala ne hi tum sab ko paida kiya hai wohi phir tumhein faut karega, tum mein aise bhi hain jo badtareen umr ki taraf lautaaye jaate hain ke bahut kuch jaanne boojhne ke baad bhi na jaanen. Beshak Allah daana aur tawaana hai.
ayahs.71: Allah Taala hi ne tum mein se ek ko doosre par rozi mein ziyaadti de rakhi hai, pas jinhein ziyaadti di gayi hai woh apni rozi apne maatehat ghulaamon ko nahi dete ke woh aur yeh is mein baraabar ho jaayen, to kya yeh log Allah ki nematon ke munkir ho rahe hain?
ayahs.72: Allah Taala ne tumhare liye tum mein se hi tumhari biwiyaan paida keen aur tumhari biwiyon se tumhare liye tumhare bete aur pote paida kiye aur tumhein achchi achchi cheezein khaane ko dein. Kya phir bhi log baatil par imaan laayenge? Aur Allah Taala ki nematon ki na-shukri karenge?
ayahs.73: Aur woh Allah Taala ke siwa un ki ibaadat karte hain jo aasmaanon aur zameen se unhein kuch bhi to rozi nahi de sakte aur na kuch qudrat rakhte hain.
ayahs.74: Pas Allah Taala ke liye misaalein mat banaao, Allah Taala khoob jaanta hai aur tum nahi jaante.
ayahs.75: Allah Taala ek misaal bayaan farmaata hai ke ek ghulaam hai doosre ki milkiyat ka, jo kisi baat ka ikhtiyaar nahi rakhta aur ek aur shakhs hai jise hum ne apne paas se maqool rozi de rakhi hai, jis mein se woh chhupe khule kharch karta hai. Kya yeh sab baraabar ho sakte hain? Allah Taala hi ke liye sab taareef hai, balke in mein se aksar nahi jaante.
ayahs.76: Allah Taala ek aur misaal bayaan farmaata hai, do shakhson ki, jin mein se ek to goonga hai aur kisi cheez par ikhtiyaar nahi rakhta balke woh apne maalik par bojh hai, kahin bhi use bheje woh koi bhalaai nahi laata, kya yeh aur woh jo adal ka hukm deta hai aur hai bhi seedhi raah par, baraabar ho sakte hain?
ayahs.77: Aasmaanon aur zameen ka ghaib sirf Allah Taala hi ko maaloom hai. Aur qayamat ka amr to aisa hi hai jaise aankh ka jhapakna, balke is se bhi ziyaada qareeb. Beshak Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.78: Allah Taala ne tumhein tumhari maaon ke peton se nikaala hai ke us waqt tum kuch bhi nahi jaante the, usi ne tumhare kaan aur aankhein aur dil banaaye ke tum shukr-guzaari karo.
ayahs.79: Kya in logon ne parindon ko nahi dekha jo taabe-farmaan ho kar faza mein hain, jinhein bajuz Allah Taala ke koi aur thaame hue nahi, beshak is mein imaan laane wale logon ke liye badi nishaaniyaan hain.
ayahs.80: Aur Allah Taala ne tumhare liye tumhare gharon mein sukoonat ki jagah bana di hai aur usi ne tumhare liye chaupaayon ki khaalon ke ghar bana diye hain, jinhein tum halka phulka paate ho apne kooch ke din aur apne thehrne ke din bhi, aur in ki oon aur roon aur baalon se bhi is ne bahut se saamaan aur ek waqt-e-muqarrara tak ke liye faaide ki cheezein banaayin.
ayahs.81: Allah hi ne tumhare liye apni paida karda cheezon mein se saaye banaaye hain aur usi ne tumhare liye pahaadon mein ghaar banaaye hain aur usi ne tumhare liye kurte banaaye hain jo tumhein garmi se bachaayen aur aise kurte bhi jo tumhein ladaai ke waqt kaam aayen. Woh isi tarah apni poori poori nematein de raha hai ke tum hukm-bardaar ban jaao.
ayahs.82: Phir bhi agar yeh munh mode rahen to aap par sirf khol kar tableegh kar dena hi hai.
ayahs.83: Yeh Allah ki nematein jaante pehchaante hue bhi in ke munkir ho rahe hain, balke in mein se aksar na-shukre hain.
ayahs.84: Aur jis din hum har ummat mein se gawaah khada karenge phir kaafiron ko na ijaazat di jaayegi aur na un se tauba karne ko kaha jaayega.
ayahs.85: Aur jab yeh zaalim azaab dekh lenge phir na to un se halka kiya jaayega aur na woh dheel diye jaayenge.
ayahs.86: Aur jab mushrikeen apne shareekon ko dekh lenge to kahenge aye hamare parwardigaar! Yehi hamare woh shareek hain jinhein hum tujhe chhod kar pukaara karte the, pas woh unhein jawaab denge ke tum bilkul hi jhoote ho.
ayahs.87: Is din woh sab (aajiz ho kar) Allah ke saamne itaat ka iqraar pesh karenge aur jo bohtan-baazi kiya karte the woh sab un se gum ho jaayegi.
ayahs.88: Jinhon ne kufr kiya aur Allah ki raah se roka hum unhein azaab par azaab badhaate jaayenge, yeh badla hoga un ki fitna-pardaaziyon ka.
ayahs.89: Aur jis din hum har ummat mein inhi mein se un ke muqaable par gawaah khada karenge aur tujhe un sab par gawaah bana kar laayenge aur hum ne tujh par yeh kitaab naazil farmaayi hai jis mein har cheez ka shaafi bayaan hai, aur hidayat aur rahmat aur khushkhabri hai musalmaanon ke liye.
ayahs.90: Allah Taala adal ka, bhalaai ka aur qaraabat-daaron ke saath sulook karne ka hukm deta hai aur be-hayaai ke kaamon, nashaista harkaton aur zulm-o-ziyaadti se rokta hai, woh khud tumhein naseehatein kar raha hai ke tum naseehat haasil karo.
ayahs.91: Aur Allah ke ahd ko poora karo jab ke tum aapas mein qaul-o-qaraar karo aur qasmon ko in ki pukhtagi ke baad mat todo, haalaanke tum Allah Taala ko apna zaamin thehra chuke ho, tum jo kuch karte ho Allah is ko ba-khoobi jaan raha hai.
ayahs.92: Aur us aurat ki tarah na ho jaao jis ne apna soot mazboot kaatne ke baad tukde tukde kar ke tod daala, ke tum apni qasmon ko aapas ke makr ka baais thehrao, is liye ke ek giroh doosre giroh se badha chadha ho jaaye. Baat sirf yehi hai ke is ahd se Allah tumhein aazma raha hai. Yaqeenan Allah Taala tumhare liye qayamat ke din har us cheez ko khol kar bayaan kar dega jis mein tum ikhtilaaf kar rahe the.
ayahs.93: Agar Allah chaahta tum sab ko ek hi giroh bana deta lekin woh jise chaahe gumraah karta hai aur jise chaahe hidayat deta hai, yaqeenan tum jo kuch kar rahe ho is ke baare mein baaz-purs ki jaane wali hai.
ayahs.94: Aur tum apni qasmon ko aapas ki dagha-baazi ka bahaana na banaao. Phir to tumhare qadam apni mazbooti ke baad dagmaga jaayenge aur tumhein sakht saza bardaasht karna padegi kyunke tum ne Allah ki raah se rok diya aur tumhein bada sakht azaab hoga.
ayahs.95: Tum Allah ke ahd ko thode mol ke badle na bech diya karo. Yaad rakho Allah ke paas ki cheez hi tumhare liye behtar hai, bashart-ke tum mein ilm ho.
ayahs.96: Tumhare paas jo kuch hai sab faani hai aur Allah Taala ke paas jo kuch hai baaqi hai. Aur sabr karne walon ko hum bhale aamaal ka behtareen badla zaroor ata farmaayenge.
ayahs.97: Jo shakhs nek amal kare mard ho ya aurat, lekin ba-imaan ho to hum use yaqeenan nihaayat behtar zindagi ata farmaayenge. Aur un ke nek aamaal ka behtar badla bhi unhein zaroor zaroor denge.
ayahs.98: Quran padhne ke waqt raande hue shaitaan se Allah ki panaah talab karo.
ayahs.99: Imaan walon aur apne parwardigaar par bharosa rakhne walon par is ka zor mutlaqan nahi chalta.
ayahs.100: Haan is ka ghalba un par to yaqeenan hai jo usi se rifaqat karen aur use Allah ka shareek thehraayen.
ayahs.101: Aur jab hum kisi aayat ki jagah doosri aayat badal dete hain aur jo kuch Allah Taala naazil farmaata hai use woh khoob jaanta hai to yeh kehte hain ke tu to bohtan-baaz hai. Baat yeh hai ke in mein se aksar jaante hi nahi.
ayahs.102: Keh dijiye ke ise aap ke Rabb ki taraf se Jibraeel haq ke saath le kar aaye hain taake imaan walon ko Allah Taala istiqaamat ata farmaaye aur musalmaanon ki rahnumaai aur bushaarat ho jaaye.
ayahs.103: Hamein ba-khoobi ilm hai ke yeh kaafir kehte hain ke ise to ek aadmi sikhaata hai, is ki zabaan jis ki taraf yeh nisbat kar rahe hain ajami hai aur yeh Quran to saaf Arabi zabaan mein hai.
ayahs.104: Jo log Allah Taala ki aayaton par imaan nahi rakhte unhein Allah ki taraf se bhi rahnumaai nahi hoti aur un ke liye alamnak azaab hain.
ayahs.105: Jhoot iftira to wohi baandhte hain jinhein Allah Taala ki aayaton par imaan nahi hota. Yehi log jhoote hain.
ayahs.106: Jo shakhs apne imaan ke baad Allah se kufr kare bajuz is ke jis par jabr kiya jaaye aur is ka dil imaan par barqaraar ho, magar jo log khule dil se kufr karen to un par Allah ka ghazab hai aur inhi ke liye bahut bada azaab hai.
ayahs.107: Yeh is liye ke unhon ne dunya ki zindagi ko aakhirat se ziyaada mahboob rakha. Yaqeenan Allah Taala kaafir logon ko raah-e-raast nahi dikhaata.
ayahs.108: Yeh woh log hain jin ke dilon par aur jin ke kaanon par aur jin ki aankhon par Allah ne mohr laga di hai aur yehi log ghaafil hain.
ayahs.109: Kuch shak nahi ke yehi log aakhirat mein sakht nuqsaan uthaane wale hain.
ayahs.110: Jin logon ne fitnon mein daale jaane ke baad hijrat ki phir jihaad kiya aur sabr ka saboot diya beshak tera parwardigaar in baaton ke baad unhein bakhshne wala aur mehrbaaniyan karne wala hai.
ayahs.111: Jis din har shakhs apni zaat ke liye ladta jhagadta aaye aur har shakhs ko is ke kiye hue aamaal ka poora badla diya jaayega aur logon par (mutlaqan) zulm na kiya jaayega.
ayahs.112: Allah Taala is basti ki misaal bayaan farmaata hai jo poore amn-o-itminaan se thi, is ki rozi is ke paas ba-faraaghat har jagah se chali aa rahi thi. Phir is ne Allah Taala ki nematon ka kufr kiya to Allah Taala ne use bhookh aur dar ka maza chakhaaya jo badla tha un ke kartooton ka.
ayahs.113: Un ke paas inhi mein se Rasool pahuncha phir bhi unhon ne use jhutlaaya pas unhein azaab ne aa dabocha aur woh the hi zaalim.
ayahs.114: Jo kuch halaal aur paakeeza rozi Allah ne tumhein de rakhi hai use khaao aur Allah ki nemat ka shukr karo agar tum usi ki ibaadat karte ho.
ayahs.115: Tum par sirf murdaar aur khoon aur soor ka gosht aur jis cheez par Allah ke siwa doosre ka naam pukaara jaaye haraam hain, phir agar koi shakhs be-bas kar diya jaaye na woh khwahish-mand ho aur na hadd se guzarne wala ho to yaqeenan Allah bakhshne wala rahm karne wala hai.
ayahs.116: Kisi cheez ko apni zabaan se jhoot-moot na keh diya karo ke yeh halaal hai aur yeh haraam hai ke Allah par jhoot bohtan baandh lo, samajh lo ke Allah Taala par bohtan-baazi karne wale kaamyaabi se mahroom hi rehte hain.
ayahs.117: Unhein bahut mamooli faaida milta hai aur un ke liye hi dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.118: Aur yahudiyon par jo kuch hum ne haraam kiya tha use hum pehle hi se aap ko suna chuke hain, hum ne un par zulm nahi kiya balke woh khud apni jaanon par zulm karte rahe.
ayahs.119: Jo koi jahaalat se bure amal kar le phir tauba kar le aur islaah bhi kar le to phir aap ka Rabb bila shak-o-shubha badi bakhshish karne wala aur nihaayat hi mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.120: Be-shak Ibraheem peshwa aur Allah Taala ke farmaanbardaar aur yak-tarfa mukhlis the. Woh mushrikon mein se na the.
ayahs.121: Allah Taala ki nematon ke shukr-guzaar the, Allah ne unhein apna bar-guzida kar liya tha aur unhein raah-e-raast sujha di thi.
ayahs.122: Hum ne use dunya mein bhi behtari di thi aur be-shak woh aakhirat mein bhi neko-kaaron mein hain.
ayahs.123: Phir hum ne aap ki jaanib wahi bheji ke aap millat-e-Ibraheem Haneef ki pairwi karen, jo mushrikon mein se na the.
ayahs.124: Hafte ke din ki azmat to sirf un logon ke zimme hi zaroori ki gayi thi jinhon ne is mein ikhtilaaf kiya tha, baat yeh hai ke aap ka parwardigaar khud hi in mein in ke ikhtilaaf ka faisla qayamat ke din karega.
ayahs.125: Apne Rabb ki raah ki taraf logon ko hikmat aur behtareen naseehat ke saath bulaaiye aur un se behtareen tareeqe se guftagu kijiye, yaqeenan aap ka Rabb apni raah se bahakne walon ko bhi ba-khoobi jaanta hai aur woh raah-yaafta logon se bhi poora waaqif hai.
ayahs.126: Aur agar badla lo bhi to bilkul utna hi jitna sadma tumhein pahunchaaya gaya ho aur agar sabr kar lo to be-shak saabiron ke liye yehi behtar hai.
ayahs.127: Aap sabr karen, baghair taufeeq-e-Ilahi ke aap sabr kar hi nahi sakte aur un ke haal par ranjeeda na hon aur jo makr-o-fareb yeh karte rehte hain un se tang-dil na hon.
ayahs.128: Yaqeen maano ke Allah Taala parhezgaaron aur nek-kaaron ke saath hai.
